+"""Record preparation steps.
+
+``prepare_with`` validates and normalizes a record and attaches a display
+string produced by a pluggable renderer; ``prepare`` uses the pytest
+ASCII-escaped diagnostic rendering.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import ascii_escaped
+
+
+def escape_display(value: Any) -> str:
+    """Render a str or bytes value with the pytest ASCII-escaped semantics."""
+    if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
+        raise ValueError(f"value must be str or bytes, got {type(value).__name__}")
+    return ascii_escaped(value)
+
+
+def validate_record(record: Any) -> tuple[str, Any, bool]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return its trimmed key, value and enabled flag."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"record must be a dict, got {type(record).__name__}")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare_with(record: Any, display: Callable[[Any], str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a new prepared record whose display is ``display(value)``.
+
+    The input record is never mutated.
+    """
+    key, value, enabled = validate_record(record)
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": display(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }
+
+
+def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare ``record`` with an ASCII-escaped display of its value."""
+    return prepare_with(record, escape_display)

 def prepare(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Prepare ``record`` with an ASCII-escaped display of its value."""
     return prepare_with(record, escape_display)
+
+
+def batch(records: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order; duplicate trimmed keys raise ValueError."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError(f"records must be a list, got {type(records).__name__}")
+    prepared = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
